summary: One branch-wide autoreview pass over the PH-1 diff (base 9716924), plus three local passes during implementation. Every concrete bypass the reviews found in the capture gate is closed and covered by a regression test: fenced examples, HTML comments, indented top-level fences, list-nested fences that outdent, verbatim raw blocks, and container blocks. Two findings are recorded non-blocking with reasoning rather than patched. The final container-tag finding was fixed in 2b9ce1d, one commit after the review run that raised it; verify is green at that commit.

non_blocking_findings.summary: Raised four times as 'replaying the ledger in file order reactivates completed quickfixes'. Refuted against the code: quickfix.cmd_list builds a set of ids carrying a done event and tests membership, board.quickfix_ledger collects done events only, and cmd_start counts openers - none replay in order. Active state lives in .factory/quickfix.json, not the ledger, and every event carries its own started_at/completed_at. The scrambling is real and came from the union-merge driver reordering an append-only ledger during a cherry-pick; the file was not hand-edited because it is evidence written by forge quickfix.

An unterminated fence, comment or raw block masks nothing rather than running to end of document. CommonMark says such a construct runs to EOF, so this is a deliberate deviation toward the wrong-refusal asymmetry: a stray opener is a typo, and refusing a document whose sections are plainly written is the failure this story exists to remove, while over-counting only routes the author to the grill spec confirm requires anyway. An earlier round of this same review argued the opposite direction, filing the EOF-masking behaviour as a defect.

residual_risks: Structure detection approximates a CommonMark block parser rather than being one. Setext headings, link reference definitions and block quotes are not interpreted. factory/scripts is stdlib-only by design (check_dual_runtime.py's allowlist), so adopting a parser is a decision record rather than a patch - recommended as its own story alongside PH-2 and PH-3.
Review cycles stopped converging: rounds alternated between two defensible readings of unterminated constructs. Further rounds were judged to alternate rather than converge (decision 0005).
